item.title: By The Numbers: Escambia County EMS Responded To Over 93,000 Calls In 2025
item.description: It was a busy year for Escambia County EMS in 2025 with over 93,000 calls for service. According to numbers released by the county on Monday, Escambia EMS responded to the following in 2025: 93,682 calls for service 56,323 transports 2,860 CORE appointments 4,985 motor vehicle accidents 978 cardiac arrests 410 standby events (such as sporting events, air shows, events) Additional EMS stats [...]
